notes.title: Bosses and guests
notes.notes:
[p][i]Hi, chefs![/i]

Today, let’s look closer at the customers you will serve! 

Guests are an important part of Abra-Cooking-Dabra, as they provide you with orders. Customers come, leave, and wait for their food. A funny animation here, a strange interaction there help us to make them look more alive and to highlight their peculiarity.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/e6248b53070521533d0a2d5c604882ff425a6946.gif"][/img][/p][p]
Beside regular customers, most levels feature a special guest, which appears only if you successfully serve all regulars. What makes them special? For one, they rarely ask for usual dishes and instead order something special. Such food requires rare ingredients, which you get as a reward from previous customers. Also, serving special guests can unlock a secret level! But let’s meet some of them.

Mr. Walrus may look menacing with those massive tusks, but actually he is a very kind gentleman (as long as you keep feeding him, but who doesn’t get angry when they are hungry?)

[url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/cbe8a5b462f9ee731ca5a1407343f706d266f87b.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/cbe8a5b462f9ee731ca5a1407343f706d266f87b.gif"][/img][/url][/p][p]
Our next guest is a famous archaeologist Kara Loft… Oh, right, she wants to keep incognito, whoops. Meet an unknown masked woman with pistols!

[url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/a01989d73029cc0e490a924e05284a5ad515ce4a.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/a01989d73029cc0e490a924e05284a5ad515ce4a.gif"][/img][/url]

However, some guests are so important, your whole restaurant gets reserved for them only. These bosses will also try to mess with you… a lot. It’s up to you to make them change their mind with your cooking!

The first of such guests is Sir Dodo. He will try to freeze your ingredients… which wouldn’t be so bad if his friend weren’t setting them on fire.

[url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/83c28307b84ca1ca972a828de78533c10e657572.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/83c28307b84ca1ca972a828de78533c10e657572.gif"][/img][/url]

And a visitor from far away: Caterpillar! She can command darkness and hide your ingredients from you.

[url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/8c3c9f43ae39d42501e76fb987f3722b4ef8d7c4.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/8c3c9f43ae39d42501e76fb987f3722b4ef8d7c4.gif"][/img][/url]

Also, as a small bonus: you will be able to offer your customers drinks! Brew the traditional British beverage — tea:

[url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/ef38b2944eb0b962981c012bdca827b6fb4fd400.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/ef38b2944eb0b962981c012bdca827b6fb4fd400.gif"][/img][/url]

and for those who can’t start their day without coffee:

[url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/4560d3dd86befe38a4c9364b99ba23fe5af06279.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/4560d3dd86befe38a4c9364b99ba23fe5af06279.gif"][/img][/url]

That’s it for today! But we’ll be back with more news and info about Abra-Cooking-Dabra soon, stay tuned!

[i]Yours, the Door 407 dev team
[/i][/p]

notes.title: New utensils!
notes.notes:
[i]Hi, chefs![/i]

We continue improving the game and, among other things, it includes adding new content! In Abra-Cooking-Dabra new content means new tools to cook with. So today we’ll tell you a bit about it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/ce323d6fc2bf4b6b91dcda7804c8db3b4cd501ec.jpg[/img]
One of the most important and fun parts of the game is when you obtain new utensils. In the demo you can try using knives and graters. There are also a few recipes that involve frying and boiling ingredients. But a true chef always needs more utensils! So what tools can you play with in later stages? Let’s see some of them!

One of the new utensils is a whisk. An essential tool for every chef, it will allow you to stir ingredients (like eggs) to use in more complex recipes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/71f5ed9dda7a4ba2b9bbaa014df6f5038e2933d2.gif[/img]

The next on the list is a masher. Yep, the one that helps you mash boiled potatoes! And not only them, but also boiled carrots, parsnips and swedes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/5aa051b7fed6a1c0b051354937a891a872da00ab.gif[/img]

A mill can be used to make flour from grain. Then it can be processed into dough - you can then make some bread out of it, or use in other baking recipes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/fbcc123f9a55b1dd59dc2492b5fba61566892a52.gif[/img]

Thirsty? Use a juicer to make some tomato or carrot juice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/1beb1b38e14888e730ae3687036602f78fa4048c.gif[/img]

And last but not least is not even a utensil, but a new farm animal - beside a chicken you’ll be able to milk a cow. Feed it with a few vegetables and get some milk later!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/c844d2b201412d877250adf2a203d83301ab8657.gif[/img]

This is it for today, but soon you’ll learn more about new tools, guests and further explore the exciting world of Abra-Cooking-Dabra!

[i]Yours, the Door 407 dev team[/i]

notes.title: Playtest start!
Chef’s Diary. Part 9
notes.notes:
[i]Hi, chefs![/i]

What is essential for any kitchen? Of course, it is utensils! So today I’ll show you what I use.

The most important chef’s tool is definitely a knife. You can’t cook anything if you can’t cut it. I already have two, and believe me - the more experienced a chef, the more knives they have!

Then I have a grater. It really helps with some dishes, but isn’t required for all. Still, it’s nice to keep one around!

And of course there is also a pan and a pot. I don’t cook only salads here, you know! And you need something to cook on: a stove. I have that too!

There’s also a variety of plates and sauce plates. Some are disposable, and once a dish is served they go in trash. Others can be used multiple times - but I need to wash them first. Luckily, for that I have a sink!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/e1694a02b4d893c8a4802d44e441de4ce5df2aa5.png[/img]
[i]And that's it for today from your Royal Chef![/i]

notes.title: Chef’s Diary. Part 8
notes.notes:
[i]Hi, chefs![/i]

Last time I explained a bit about seeds I grow in my garden. But there’s more! Beside the first seed pack, I have another one. It contains potato, asparagus, watercress, parsnip, swede and leeks!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/627ef2c331966c110e585848dbeb10fd8dcf3d90.gif[/img]

The planting process is the same, but cooking… Dishes are much more complex with these ingredients. I need to boil, roast, stew, bake and so much more. My head is spinning!

[i]And that's it for today from your Royal Chef![/i]

notes.title: Chef’s Diary. Part 7
notes.notes:
[i]Hi, chefs![/i]

You already know that I farm for my ingredients, but what exactly is growing in my garden?

I started with growing what I call a “salad set”: cucumbers, tomatoes, onions, parsley, cabbages, carrots. You probably imagine where I get seeds. Yes, I buy them, and as usual, I get 3 plants in a pack of seeds. Then I plant them, they grow very fast (truly a wonderland!) and I get enough ingredients for 2 dishes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/870c90a9a6986523d7f9b9513174e22a23807a7e.gif[/img]

What kinds of dishes? Well, mostly various salads, though lately I started making dishes with stewed cabbage!

[i]And that's it for today from your Royal Chef![/i]

notes.title: Chef’s Diary. Part 6
notes.notes:
[i]Hi, chefs![/i]

Today, I’ll tell you a bit about sauces! So, how do I get them?

I buy some!.. I wish I could say that, but it’s a bit more complicated. When buying sauces, I get a pack. There are 3 bottles in there, each filled with some kind of dressing. But what I find there is always random. For now there are 6 sauces I can possibly get: sunseed oil, lemon juice, mustard, mayonnaise, olive oil and vinegar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/4914081eccde354eb7430ccd6101a2a130bcc42c.gif[/img]

That’s not all, however. Occasionally guests ask for “something special”, and then I need to figure out how to make them sauce of their choice. So I mix the sauces I buy to get more!

[i]And that's it for today from your Royal Chef![/i]

notes.title: Chef’s Diary. Part 5
notes.notes:
[i]Hi, chefs![/i]

I continue working at the Royal Kitchen. Every day more and more guests come. I find that the tools I started with aren’t enough anymore… So, I need more!

While I can buy sauces, disposable plates and seeds anytime, I need different things - knives, plates, sauce cups, gardens and maybe even a fridge.

Luckily, the cat introduced me to a local shopkeeper. Now I can buy all of that stuff! And who knows what will appear in the shop in future…

Mad Hatter’s Shop (WIP)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/212a28681c73c375ff9af70b235b0184b28a3505.jpg[/img]
[i]That's it for today from your Royal Chef![/i]

notes.title: Chef’s Diary. Part 4
notes.notes:
[i]Happy New Year, Chefs![/i]

It’s me again! Working at the royal kitchen goes well. My days are filled with cooking, growing and managing orders.

Yeah, all is fine… Was fine till yesterday. Apparently some guests aren’t happy with my becoming Royal Chef, so they decided to mess with me!

They use weird abilities… Some of them can set the whole kitchen on fire, some cause an earthquake so everything falls and others can freeze my ingredients.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/1cca5932360a5c4be79d27bfbbe96c0e98b906af.gif[/img]

Unfortunately for them, that’s not enough to stop me. I can put everything back where I need it, thaw frozen stuff in the oven and even put down fires!

The only question is what they’ll come up with next.

[i]That's it for today from your Royal Chef![/i]

notes.title: Chef’s Diary. Part 3
notes.notes:
[i]Merry Christmas, Chefs![/i]

My cooking days continue, and the number of tasks I have to do keeps increasing. Last time I explained the process of cooking dishes. But I didn't mention where I get the ingredients.

[b]I grow them.[/b]

Yes, I know, you probably think it's impossible, yet here we are. The cat says it's magic, but I'm inclined to think it's something in the soil.

Or maybe it's seeds? Could they be genetically modified? Because I can't get seeds from my harvest and replant them. I have to use coins and buy new ones…

Anyway, it's quite simple. Buy seeds, throw them in a planter, wait… And collect your harvest!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/f04157a1dcadd3c335bdc064f83c05cf43e7836a.gif[/img]

[i]That's it for today from your Royal Chef![/i]

notes.title: Chef’s Diary. Part 2
notes.notes:
[i]Hey, it’s me again! [/i]

Today I cooked my first dishes. It wasn’t that hard — at least, for now. Just some easy and quick salads.

So, how exactly does it go? First I take the order, and since I have no idea what the exact recipe is, I ask the customer to write the ingredients on a note. Not something you’d be asked in a regular restaurant, so I tell people that it is required so we can make their dishes exactly how they want them (can’t believe it works). Then I just need to follow the recipe. Let’s take today’s salad for example. First I cut a cucumber, then peeled an onion, then cut it nicely, got everything on a plate, and gave the dish to the customer with a dressing of their choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/0f53157c7cd4f8c7655c9c28722cb26a80263ba2.gif[/img]

Yep, that’s it. Well, first I need to buy the dressing and you don’t always get the one you need right away, but I’ll write about it next time.

[i]That’s it for today from your Royal Chef![/i]

notes.title: Chef’s Diary. Part 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300998/47488539e6f8522e178c44c06f5a42aeff978037.png[/img]

[i]Strangest things have happened… so I decided to record it all in this diary. But let’s start from the beginning.[/i]

Today promised to be a normal day. Morning and noon went as usual. And as usual, I went for my evening stroll in Camden Market. I was there lots of times and thought I knew all the stores there, but this evening I noticed an antique shop I’d never seen before. I, obviously, couldn’t pass it. So I went in, browsed some rarities and was about to leave when my eyes fell on a strange book. With no second thought, I opened it… and it burst into flames!

In its place appeared a cat who accused me of destroying the book. Yes. [b]The cat was talking[/b]. But stranger things were about to happen. Not listening to my more than reasonable arguments, the cat disappeared. And the shop disappeared. I was standing in some strange kitchen and a strange woman was looking at me angrily. The cat again put the blame on me for destroying the book — a family treasure for this woman, apparently, though I’d say one should not keep their treasures in antique shops. Furious, the Duchess (that’s what the cat called the woman) was about to order her people to execute us, but the cat’s sweet words made her change her mind. Now I (don’t listen to what the cat says, I don’t believe it’s going to work at all) have to become a Royal Chef and ensure an upcoming grand feast will go well.

[i]That’s it for today from your Royal Chef![/i]

notes.title: Welcome to Abra-Cooking-Dabra!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Today we present you [b]Abra-Cooking-Dabra[/b] — a cozy craft & cooking card game with puzzle and management elements. Unleash your culinary talents!

Imagine finding yourself in a wonderland… But in the company of an obnoxious talking cat. Threatened to be executed for destroying (totally by accident!) an old recipe book — an essential artifact for the upcoming Royal feast. Now you have no other option but to cook and restore the lost recipes of eldritch British cuisine, serving food to various guests and bosses who play various tricks to mess with you. 

The cooking process in the game is simple. Get an order, get ingredients, and try to cook the dish ordered. Should be easy peasy. Or not. Build and manage your cooking deck of cards, upgrade utensils, farm fresh ingredients and manage your cooking nicely to please picky guests. Every guest gives a hint of what ingredients to use in the dish they ordered, but figure out how to cook them yourself - and dishes get more complicated as you progress through levels. 

So, [b]what[/b] exactly awaits you in the game?
[list]
[*] 30+ game levels to master
[*] 100+ outstanding recipes 
[*] 10+ various guests
[*] 20+ ingredients to farm 
[*] 1 nasty cat[/list]
And most importantly, [b]when[/b]?

We plan to release the game in [b]Q2 2025[/b].

Wishlist the game so you don’t miss dinner time! Join our social media and follow our news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021530

We’ll return with desserts of news about the game!

[i]Yours, the Door 407 dev team[/i]
